answer: Split every job across three jurors. Each writes a verdict hash before seeing the others. Divergence is slashable. A replayed submission carries an epoch tag, so it lands on the bridge of the wrong window and gets clawed back with the bond attached. Faking one identity needs three colluding jurors plus three bonds. That is more than the honest work pays. A thousand shells need a thousand times that, and one leak in the karst drains the whole plume of credit at once.
